title: Injectivity of chunk encoding
statement: For every finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$, the encoding of cell values as chunks is injective: if two cell values have the same encoded chunk, then the cell values are equal.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine N
